title: California · Big Sur Highway 1 Dream Section
slogan: A 440 km loop out of Bixby Creek Bridge
story: Cliffs, bridges and one of the world’s great coastal rides. 440 km from Carmel Valley Village to Carmel Valley Village, about 7 h 36 of riding. On the way it passes Big Sur village, Pfeiffer coast, Ragged Point and back through Pfeiffer coast. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.

title: California · Mount Tam and Point Reyes
slogan: Redwoods, coast and a short ride that feels expensive.
story: Redwoods, coast and a short ride that feels expensive. A 140 km loop that starts and ends near Kentfield, about 2 h 42 of riding. On the way it passes Stinson Beach, Point Reyes Station and Tomales Bay. The climb of the day is Mount Tamalpais. It is a high-mountain day.

title: California · Sierra Nevada Yosemite Doorway
slogan: A 480 km loop out of Placerville fuel
story: Gold-country foothills and granite promise. Out of Placerville and back again: 480 km, roughly 9 h 14 in the saddle. The stops in between: Yosemite west and Mariposa. Sonora Pass approach is the high point. It tops out at about 2,150 m. It is a high-mountain day.
